_doc: Kodiak v6.0.1 — operator-tunable config. Wallet/chatId/decision_model resolved from env vars at runtime install (${WALLET_ADDRESS}, ${TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}, ${KODIAK_DECISION_MODEL}); do NOT hardcode here. Risk gates, leverage caps, and asset cooldowns are enforced by the runtime via runtime.yaml and the producer's hardcoded constants.

leverage._v6_change: Was 10x in v5.1 — drove -17.8% / -$178 over 26 trades. Single-asset SOL chop at 10x amplified per-trade variance. v6.0 drops to 5x default; same signal selection, half the variance.

marginPct._note: 20% of account value per slot. Override per-deploy via KODIAK_MARGIN_PCT env var.

entry._note: v5.1 base-tech-score floor preserved verbatim. Producer constants WIN — config is informational/audit only in v6.

_runtime_owns._doc: These were v5 concerns. In v6, the runtime owns them via runtime.yaml.guard_rails. DO NOT add gates here.
_runtime_owns.execution.exitOrderType: runtime.exit.order_type (FEE_OPTIMIZED_LIMIT, ensure_execution_as_taker:true — taker fallback as safety floor on Phase 1 stops)
